title: Slovenia, 1 dollar, Amber Route

specs.Decoration: high relief, antique finish, amber insert

descriptionPlain: Description The Amber Road was an ancient trade route linking the Baltic coast with the Mediterranean world, fostering the growth of cities and the exchange of goods, cultures, and ideas. Slovenia, the second coin in the series, refers to Roman Emona, one of the oldest colonies in this region, located at the crossroads of routes leading toward the Adriatic and Aquileia. Discover the story of this route and collect all nine coins in this exceptional collection that tells of its lasting civilizational significance.
